title: Small-cohort conversion and feedback retention playbook for lighthouse beta
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Playbook to convert a 10-20 lighthouse cohort from beta to paid pilots while preserving a high-signal feedback loop for product quality and release note accuracy. Focus areas: conversion funnel tracking, retention of active feedback contributors, cross-team runbooks for release notes and customer communications, and post-pilot measurement of unit economics. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, Docs, Support, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success activities for a constrained cohort pilot.
acceptance_criteria: Define and instrument conversion funnel from activation -> 7-day active -> pilot conversion (trial to paid) with dashboard available to stakeholders
Feedback loop established: at least 3 structured feedback cycles per account with triage tags and owners assigned
Release notes synchronized with product changes and customer-impact callouts; docs PR merged and staged before pilot-wide communications
GTM communications runbook validated with legal and support, and one dry-run executed with internal stakeholders
Pilot KPI baseline and post-pilot economics report template created and agreed by PM, Sales Eng, and CS
milestones: M2: Early cohort activation + onboarding checklist completed (2026-02-18)

M5: Pilot conversion review and economics report (2026-03-25)
playbook_steps: Select 10 lighthouse accounts prioritized by strategic fit and likelihood to provide qualitative feedback
Run 2-week onboarding sprints with CS + Solutions Eng; document common blockers in Confluence
Weekly feedback triage sessions with Product, Eng, and CS; record severity and follow-up owner
Coordinate release notes: one-line customer impact, mitigation/fallback, sample payloads, and suggested support responses
Sync GTM: announce opt-in windows, provide account-specific onboarding windows, and schedule executive check-ins
coordination_tasks: Docs: create /beta/lighthouse release notes draft and link to staged examples (owner: Priya Shah)
Eng: add conversion metrics to GaugeBoard and flag anomalies (owner: Daniel Kim)

Analytics: configure cohort analysis in Looker and set alerts for 7-day drop-offs (owner: Rachel Boyd)
risks: Cohort too small to produce statistically meaningful conversion signals; rely on qualitative signals
Early regressions in runtime could bias feedback and reduce trust from lighthouse accounts
Docs/release notes lagging behind code merges, leading to support confusion
Over-indexing on feature requests from lighthouse accounts that are not representative of broader market
decisions: Scope: limit initial cohort to 12 accounts to prioritize deep feedback over breadth (approved 2026-01-15)
Rollout gating: require <=5% critical errors in first 72 hours for expansion (decision 2026-02-02)
Release notes format: customer-impact, sample API snippet, known limitations, and mitigation steps (agreed 2026-02-20)
